# Asian & Pacific American Heritage Month

> > Official federal resource for Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander Heritage Month, featuring programs from the Library of Congress, Smithsonian Institution, National Archives, and other federal agencies.

This government website commemorates the May observance established by Congress, highlighting the contributions and history of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders through digital exhibits, educational resources, and cultural programming from federal institutions.

## Key Topics

- Asian American and Pacific Islander heritage
- AANHPI History
- Library of Congress collections
- Smithsonian Institution programs
- National Archives resources
- Pacific Islander heritage (Guam, Samoa)
- Congressional designation and history
- May Heritage Month observance
- Asian American artists
- Federal cultural agencies
- Museum resources and exhibits
- Digital archives
- Cultural heritage preservation
- National Park Service sites
- Educational programming

## About AAPI Heritage Month

- [Asian & Pacific American Heritage Month](https://asianpacificheritage.gov/): Homepage celebrating AAPI heritage with federal agency resources
- [History and Background](https://asianpacificheritage.gov/About.html): History of AAPI Heritage Month from Carter era to congressional designation

## Events and Programs

- [2025 Heritage Month Events](https://asianpacificheritage.gov/Events.html): 2025 AAPI Heritage Month events from Smithsonian and federal agencies

## Digital Collections and Archives

- [Exhibits and Collections](https://asianpacificheritage.gov/ExhibitsandCollections.html): Digital archives and exhibits on Asian American and Pacific Islander history
- [Historical Images](https://asianpacificheritage.gov/Images.html): Photo gallery of AAPI historical images from Library of Congress
- [Audio and Video Resources](https://asianpacificheritage.gov/AudioandVideo.html): Video collection from Library of Congress and public broadcasting archives
